name: phase328-groq-compound-mini-completion-receipt-boundary
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A deterministic executor receives an authenticated provider completion. It persists the provider-neutral completion receipt before releasing resource permits, then reconciles observed tokens with a cancellation-proof local context. If process loss occurs after receipt commit but before permit release, the receipt is durable and recovery has evidence of the completed call. Exact keys/types: receipt_before_release=true; cancellation_blocks_receipt=false; recovery_evidence="durable_completion_receipt"; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0. Do not choose recovery, accounting, routing, retries, or writes.
